items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: detailed component concept art for the original VEILBOUND HUNTERS game.
Reference images 1 and 2 are the approved front and left-side Galdros tier-2 armor; image 3 is the world style reference. Derive a clean close-up of ONLY its single helmet, unworn, for a 3D artist. Do not reproduce the person or the full outfit.
Subject: a low close-fitting domed helmet formed from a few broad gray-brown stone plates, thin muted bronze edging, a riveted bronze forehead band, two bands crossing across the dome, a small flat rock surface at the top, short nose guard, one large left cheek plate and a noticeably smaller right cheek plate, and a short nape plate. Add a practical brown leather chin strap with buckle beneath the opening. The opening must leave eyes, mouth and chin unobstructed if worn. Use large quiet stone faces with a few chips, not a fine polygon mesh or mosaic. No horns, feathers, tall crest, glow or gold plating. Keep the source's low thick silhouette and bronze-to-stone ratio.
Composition: one helmet only, close up, front three-quarter view looking slightly toward the helmet's larger LEFT cheek plate; the asymmetric cheeks and hollow face opening should be legible. Entire helmet and chin strap visible with 10 percent margin. Square image, 1536x1536 if possible. Soft even studio lighting, pale warm gray flat plain background; no floor shadow, no mannequin, no human head, no hands, no labels, no text, no border. Semi-realistic painted production illustration with readable structure, leather backing and simple fastenings. This is an original game armor concept, not a historical replica.
